name: 水上冲关
schemaPurpose: Authoritative design geometry mapped into src/levels/water-rush.ts; this JSON itself is not loaded by the game. Runtime capabilities are implemented; physical playtest is pending.
revisionPolicy: Maintain this single formal file; no candidate, version, or backup copies.

turntable.bodyShape: non-overlapping hub plus four arm box union
turntable.visualLayerNote: Every layer follows the cross cutouts. Keep all moving geometry above Y2.90 and within radius4.11; no round under-deck or full-square slab. A .36 top plus .14 base fits the .50 body.
turntable.centerHubNote: Hub width equals arm width1.4; do not enlarge into a waiting island. Center/arm switching may remain a skilled route, not forbidden by a hidden timer.

ports.windowDefinition: Conservative projection band combining fixed tongue margin .375 at radius4 and narrower arm margin .275 at radius3.5. Not a hidden gate and not a proof of physical crossing.

carryReference.routeMeaning: Points at successive times on one moving arm, not a fixed arc walkway. Geometry does not force this route; skilled active arm switching can be allowed.

turntable.replaces: Old closed Y cylinder, radius-only sweep, coMovingBar, enlarged central waiting area and circular rim seam formulas.

routeAssessment.primary: wait for aligned arm, board, control while rotating, leave at opposite aligned port
routeAssessment.note: Do not offset ports to prevent skilled fast passage. Record center-switch shortcuts as techniques if physically valid; actual carried contact and corner falls still require tests.

turntable.implementation: CODE uses five synchronized non-overlapping kinematic boxes and one visual root. Standard physical route passed; challenge full-route validation pending. No cylinder/bounding hull.

lifts.notes: Only deck top is walkable. Underslung stems/sleeves require explicit clearance checks; no unrelated supports enter the sweep.

runup.slowTest: Start on final tangent near[-18.900000000000002,3.95,-13.799999999999999] at measured speed<=.5; original input toward-Z.
runup.runTest: Sample good/ordinary/braked four-hairpin lines before joint slope tuning; no full-speed-every-frame requirement or injected velocity.
runup.modelLimit: Ideal force/energy estimates do not prove rolling, slope transitions, or real damping behavior.
runup.slopeStatus: 50degree/4.4m selected development candidate, untested with new hairpins; do not block asset pairing on playtests

modelOwnership.dynamicOrigins: Cross rotation centre, lift body centres, individual hammer head centres and handle midpoints; metres/Y-up. Implemented and referenced by formal TS.
modelOwnership.turntableCollisionProtocol: Current CODE TurntableConfig position/parts/angularSpeed/phase/visual supports five synchronized boxes; geometry-only calculations are not a gameplay pass.

playtestStatus: Serpentine configuration and matching static model development complete. No new tests, geometry verification or playtest per user instruction. Old R8 results do not apply; difficulty balance remains unverified.

waitPoints.kind: fixed hammer lane, outside all head X collision bands

environment.style: Use the same track, rail, chassis, support and pool appearance as the first level; add only required obstacle geometry and functional cues.
environment.coverageNote: Only second-level same-style noncolliding Pool display coverage enlarged for extended start and northward high finish. First-level environment unchanged.

spatialPlan.pattern: four tight alternating hairpins progressing west, final tangent and provisional slope toward north
spatialPlan.progressNote: Current coarse axes x/z/z/z. Final snake includes turns and reversals, so this is stage progress, not accumulated distance.
spatialPlan.supersedes: Older single-column/one-hammer/closed-disk routes and the withdrawn offset-port design. Current cross ports are centered and aligned.
spatialPlan.routeMeaning: Entry quarter-turn plus4 alternating180 hairpins with4m legs, R3.5 width1.6. Last .6m tangent to untested50degree/4.4m northward slope. Prior R8 route superseded.

hammers.motionAxis: YZ arc about world X hinge; symmetric +/-Z around lane center

motion.initialAndPreview: Neutral reference model is centered; gameplay t=0 uses each instance phase. Restart restores individual phases, not a shared middle pose.
motion.pause: freeze the current time and pose, do not reset to middle
motion.handleScaling: normalized 1m handle uses constant Y scale 3.6 for all phases, never stretch per pose
motion.replaces: The old offset Z anchor and z-sine plus abs(offset)*lift formula; CODE fixed-length arc implementation is active.

clearanceAudit.status: analytic design only, no engine or final model pose validation
clearanceAudit.laneCenterWindowNote: Projection-only clearance: head Z extent is outside a radius .425 ball on Z=18; not a hidden speed/time gate or verified gameplay window.

hammerSection.neutralReference: Each model's resting head is vertically below its own centered anchor.
hammerSection.initialState: Instance phases 0/PI/PI/2; first begins right, second begins left, third starts at right extreme then reverses.
hammerSection.pause: freeze each current phase/pose; restart restores that instance's configured phase
hammerSection.observationNote: Stable lane intervals allow stopping between gates; no need to clear all three at once. Real braking and crossing are pending runtime.

hammerTimingAudit.interpretation: Same-side or same-position coincidences can occur briefly; distinct periods/phase velocities mean they are not locked in sync. Each gate has separate clear windows and fixed stopping intervals. No physical collision/playability proof.

runtimeIntegration.tests: Not run for final serpentine configuration/models per user instruction. Prior R8 results are historical.

sBend.style: four alternating 180-degree hairpins with straight legs and one tangent entry quarter-turn; actual rotated box union
sBend.instructions: Four actual alternating half-turns; preserve gaps between legs and remove all old R8 surfaces. Match every layer to rotated box union. Support spacing about4m, not one support per small segment. Last .6m tangent only. 50degree/4.4m is an untested development candidate; pairing does not wait for speed samples. Old R8 pass is historical.
